method: Use existing 16x32x32 BF16 MMA tile instead of 16x64x64 for physical prefill rows 16. Same BF16 weights, FP32 outputs and decoder. Small tile has smaller shared allocation; benefit from occupancy is a hypothesis, not established hardware evidence.
tradeoffs: More output tiles and repeated input loads; lower shared memory per threadgroup; no extra shader/weight storage. Candidate counters only when original wide route is replaced.
stage: Single-car WorldSense current-event screen: both modes warm, two ABBA blocks, four measured samples per policy/model. Fresh full three-frame/search ABBA/BAAB confirmation required before promotion.
